nodes.name: FindIPhonePurchase
nodes.role: find the record of the iPhone purchase the user names and read the amount paid

nodes.name: ComputeVatDifference
nodes.role: work out the additional VAT owed as 19.5% of the amount paid, plus the 5.29 fee, and total the two

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the Apple payee, the amount paid, the VAT difference, the fee, and the total, and get their explicit approval or refusal

nodes.name: PayAppleDifference
nodes.role: send the approved total to Apple as the VAT difference payment

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user whether the payment was sent or was not made, and why
